Caylent  is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

  The Mission  
 Caylent's Anthropic Business Unit is a dedicated AI services practice built in partnership with Anthropic — Anthropic's first pure-play delivery partner. Engagements are production-grade: agents, data products, AI-augmented operations, workforce transformation. 
 Senior FDEs run their own accounts — full relationship, from discovery through close, without anyone above managing the engagement. You scope, architect, build, and close. You are the account. 
 We hire into two specializations: Technology-Workforce FDEs run solo technical engagements in engineering and IT organizations, owning architecture decisions and LLM-native delivery end-to-end; Operational FDEs lead single-function AI adoption programs across business workforces — persona discovery, role-specific enablement, and workflow automations deployed and owned by you.

 Own the full client relationship on your account from discovery through close  
 Make architecture and build decisions appropriate to the client's environment and constraints; stand behind them 
 Run discovery, architecture reviews, and stakeholder interviews independently; translate ambiguous problems into scoped, deliverable work 
 Identify scope creep and manage it — surface risks before they become problems 
 Identify and surface expansion opportunities  
 Transfer capability that lasts: documented, runnable, maintainable software or automations that work after you leave 
 Contribute IP back to the practice after every engagement: patterns, templates, and reusable components 
 
   Your Qualifications  
 
 5+ years of engineering or technical delivery experience with meaningful time in embedded or client-facing contexts 
 Proven solo account delivery: evidence you've owned a client relationship from kickoff through close without supervision 
 Hands-on depth in one or more of: LLM application development, cloud-native architecture (AWS preferred), backend systems at scale, or enterprise business automation

 High tolerance for ambiguity; consistently delivers value before all requirements are defined
